resources.string: How to use BibliApp
Done
Mark verses as favorites with the star, highlight them in colors, or add a note.
Find any word or verse with search. More tips in More → How to use BibliApp.
Read and move around
Swipe left or right to change chapter. Tap the book name at the top to pick another book, and tap the chapter number to jump to any chapter.
Select verses
Tap a verse to select it; tap more to select several. A toolbar appears with favorite, highlight, note, copy and share. Tap ✕ to clear the selection.
Favorites
Select one or more verses and tap the star. It lights up with a little animation. Find them all later in My Library → Favorites.
Highlight in colors
Select verses, tap the brush and choose a color. Choose the ✕ in the palette to remove a highlight.
Write notes
Select a verse, tap the note icon and write your thoughts. Verses with a note show ✎. You can edit or delete it the same way.
Listen to the Bible
Tap play to hear the chapter, even with the screen off. Open the voice settings to choose the voice and speed. The app remembers where you stopped.
Search
Use the magnifier to search words or phrases. Narrow results with filters such as Old or New Testament or a specific book.
Change your Bible
Go to More → Other Bibles to switch version or download new ones. The app language follows the language of the Bible you choose.
Streak and reminders
Home shows your reading streak and progress. In More → Notifications pick the time for your daily verse and reminders.
